description: New Instagram activity since a cursor, in one request: never waits. Returns the events and the cursor to pass back next time. First call without a cursor returns only the cursor. Check on the schedule the user asked for, minutes apart, not in a loop. Read-only. (Requires INSSIST PRO.)

cursor.description: From the previous events_check answer. Omit on the first call.

instance.description: Optional. Browser instance id from account_info; defaults to the active one.

instant.description: Optional. Skip INSSIST's action pacing and run now — use only when the user asked for an unspaced or burst action.

kinds.description: Any of: dm, dm_requests, comments, likes, follows, mentions. Default: dm and dm_requests, the cheapest to check.

name: events_check
title: Events check
